text: dsh-zen-adapter 是把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DSH 的原生语言模型提供方，面向 web 客户端。它注册 zen-free provider，并从上游动态发现可用模型，把模型目录和模型选择器保持同步。插件详情页提供获取目录、逐个检测模型可用性以及查看上下文和输出上限的面板。模型信息结合在售目录与价格、限额元数据，缓存可在刷新失败时继续提供旧目录。适合希望在 DSH 中选择 OpenCode Zen 免费模型并查看当前可用状态的用户。聊天请求发往 opencode.ai，目录元数据来自 models.dev；无需配置 API key。

dsh-zen-adapter adds OpenCode Zen free models to DSH as the zen-free provider. It refreshes the catalog and picker. Its plugin panel fetches models, probes availability, and shows context and output limits. Chat goes to opencode.ai; catalog metadata comes from models.dev. No API key is required.
想在 DSH 的模型列表里添加 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型。
怎么查看哪些免费模型现在真的能响应？
I want a DSH model picker that refreshes its free-model catalog automatically.
dsh-zen-adapter 的功能「动态模型提供方」：注册 zen-free provider，并刷新 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型目录；目录更新后通知 DSH 模型选择器重新读取模型。
dsh-zen-adapter 的功能「目录面板与可用性检测」：在插件详情页获取模型目录或逐个探测免费模型，表格显示上下文、输出上限和探测状态。
dsh-zen-adapter 使用 opencode.ai 处理聊天请求，并从 models.dev 获取模型目录元数据；代码不要求用户 API key。

dsh-zen-adapter README · dsh-zen-adapter：把 [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen) 的**免费模型**接入 DeepSeek Harness，
注册为原生 provider `zen-free`。

无需注册、无需 API key、无需额外进程。

dsh-zen-adapter README · 特性：- **零配置** — 装上、重启、就能在模型选择器里选到免费模型
- **零依赖** — `dependencies` 为空，运行时复用 DSH 自带的 pi-ai，因此可以和其他
  provider 插件共存（详见[为什么零依赖很重要](#为什么零依赖很重要)）
- **动态模型目录** — 从上游实时发现，不是写死的清单，上游换模型不用等插件更新
- **可用性检测** — 区分「目录里在售」和「这台机器真的能调通」，避免选到用不了的模型
- **可视化面板** — 在插件详情页一键获取模型、检测可用性，并查看上下文大小

dsh-zen-adapter README · 版本：- **当前版本：v0.2.0** — 完整变更见 [Releases](https://github.com/seonzzy/dsh-zen-adapter/releases)
- ⚠️ **v0.1.0 与 v0.1.1 完全不可用**（每个请求 403 / 每轮 PI_AI_ERROR）。没有需要迁移的配置，直接用 v0.2.0 即可
- 上游的免费通道是未公开行为，随时可能变化；模型能不能用请以面板里的「检测可用性」为准

dsh-zen-adapter README · 前提条件：| 条件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH 版本 | 需要带 `llm.registerAdapter` 与 `webServer` 的版本 |
| Node | ≥ 20（DSH 自带，无需另装）|
| 网络 | 能访问 `opencode.ai` 与 `models.dev` |

不需要安装 pi-ai、不需要 API key、不需要 npm/pnpm 下载任何东西。

dsh-zen-adapter README · 模型选择器：安装后在对话输入框的模型选择器里会出现 **OpenCode Zen (free lane)** 分组，
选择其中一个模型即可开始对话。

目录会**动态获取**：启动时后台拉取，之后每 30 分钟自动刷新一次。

dsh-zen-adapter README · 插件面板：在「设置 → 插件 → dsh-zen-adapter」页面上有一个面板：

| 按钮 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| **获取模型** | 从上游重新拉取模型目录 |
| **检测可用性** | 逐个真实请求，测出哪些模型当前可用 |

下面的表格展示：模型名、上下文大小、输出上限、可用状态、判定依据。

> **「目录里有」不等于「能用」。** 免费模型的实际可用性受上游端点状态、
> 地区限制、以及**按 IP 计的配额**影响，随时会变。建议在新环境里点一次
> 「检测可用性」。

dsh-zen-adapter README · 模型是怎么来的：插件同时读取两个上游数据源，取交集：

| 源 | 提供 | 不提供 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opencode.ai/inference/v1/models` | 当前**在售**的模型 id | 价格、上下文 |
| `models.dev/api.json` | `cost`、`limit.context`、`limit.output` | 是否在售 |

第二个源是必需的——上游的 `/v1/models` 只返回 `{ id, object, created, owned_by }`，
**无法从它判断某模型是否免费**。

**免费判定**以 models.dev 的 `cost` 为准（`input` 与 `output` 均为 0）。
已弃用或收费的模型即使 id 带 `-free` 也不会放行——上游会把下架模型在目录里
继续挂一段时间。只有 metadata 缺失时（通常是刚发布的新模型）才退回看 `-free` 后缀。

上下文大小与输出上限同样来自 models.dev，所以界面上显示的是真实数值，
不是某个固定常数。

dsh-zen-adapter README · 模型目录缓存：两个数据源的稳定性差别很大，因此缓存策略也不同：

| 数据 | 缓存时长 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 在售模型列表 | 5 分钟 | 新模型应该尽快出现在选择器里 |
| models.dev 价格与限额 | 24 小时 | 极少变动，一天内重算没有意义 |

缓存写在 `~/.cache/dsh-zen-adapter/catalog.db`（与 `dsh-free-search` 的位置约定一致），
删除该目录即可清空，没有后台任务残留。需要换位置时设置 `ZEN_CACHE_DIR` 环境变量。

这样做带来三个实际效果：

- **启动更快** —— 不再每次拉取 models.dev 那份覆盖所有 provider 的大文件
- **离线可用** —— 断网启动时仍能列出完整模型列表
- **「获取模型」仍然是真的刷新** —— 该按钮会绕过缓存真正请求上游，不会被缓存糊弄

dsh-zen-adapter README · 为什么零依赖很重要：本插件**不声明任何 `dependencies`**，`@deepseek-ai/*` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai`
全部声明为 `peerDependencies` 且标记 `optional`。

原因：DSH 宿主自带一份 pi-ai，插件运行时沿宿主的模块树解析，全局始终只有一份。

如果插件自带一份 pi-ai，机器上就会出现**两个 pi-ai 世代**。这不只是冗余——
某些插件（例如 `dsh-workbuddy-xdpool`）会校验宿主与插件用的是不是同一世代，
不一致时整个 provider 每次调用都会失败。

因此本插件可以和其他 provider 插件**同时安装**。

dsh-zen-adapter README · 上游限制：OpenCode 的免费通道**按 IP 计配额**，部分模型还有**地区限制**。

可能遇到的情况：

| 现象 | 原因 | 怎么办 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `429` | 配额用尽或请求过密 | 等一会儿再试，或换网络节点 |
| `403 RegionError` | 该模型不对你所在地区开放 | 无法绕过，换其他模型 |
| `5xx` / `400` | 上游端点暂时故障 | 换其他模型，稍后再试 |
| 模型不在选择器里 | 尚未被判定为免费 | 点「获取模型」刷新目录 |

这些都属于**上游侧**行为，插件无法修复。用「检测可用性」可以看到每个模型的
当前状态。

dsh-zen-adapter README · 配置：本插件没有需要配置的选项。如需调整可选行为，可修改 `lib/index.js` 顶部的常量：

| 常量 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PROVIDER_ID` | `zen-free` | 在 DSH 中显示的 provider id |
| `SEED_MODELS` | 3 个模型 | 目录拉取完成前的占位列表 |
| 目录刷新间隔 | 30 分钟 | 见 `lib/index.js` 中的 `refreshTimer` |

dsh-zen-adapter README · 问题反馈：遇到问题请开 issue：<https://github.com/seonzzy/dsh-zen-adapter/issues/new>

提问前建议先搜一下已有 issue——上游行为变化引起的报错（`403`、`429`、模型突然消失）
多半已经有人遇到过，答案也在那里。

dsh-zen-adapter README · 卸载：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-zen-adapter
```

然后重启 DSH。

dsh-zen-adapter README · dsh-zen-adapter：Exposes the **free models** from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen) to DeepSeek
Harness, registered as a native provider `zen-free`.

No signup, no API key, no extra process.

English | [简体中文](README.md)

---

dsh-zen-adapter README · Features：- **Zero configuration** — install it, restart, and the free models show up in the model picker
- **Zero dependencies** — `dependencies` is empty; the plugin reuses the pi-ai that ships with
  DSH, so it can coexist with other provider plugins (see
  [why zero dependencies matters](#why-zero-dependencies-matters))
- **Live model catalog** — discovered from upstream at runtime, not a hard-coded list, so
  upstream model changes need no plugin update
- **Reachability checks** — separates "listed upstream" from "actually answers on this machine",
  so you don't pick a model that cannot respond
- **Built-in panel** — fetch the catalog and check reachability from the plugin's detail page,
  including context sizes

dsh-zen-adapter README · Versions：- **Current release: v0.2.0** — see [Releases](https://github.com/seonzzy/dsh-zen-adapter/releases)
  for the full changelog
- ⚠️ **v0.1.0 and v0.1.1 are completely unusable** (every request 403 / every turn PI_AI_ERROR).
  There is nothing to migrate — go straight to v0.2.0
- The upstream free lane is undocumented behaviour and may change at any time; trust the
  **检测可用性** button over the catalog listing

dsh-zen-adapter README · Requirements：| Requirement | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| DSH version | A version that provides `llm.registerAdapter` and `webServer` |
| Node | ≥ 20 (bundled with DSH, nothing to install) |
| Network | Reachable `opencode.ai` and `models.dev` |

No pi-ai install, no API key, nothing for npm/pnpm to download.

dsh-zen-adapter README · Model picker：After installation the **OpenCode Zen (free lane)** group appears in the model picker at the
conversation input. Select any model in it to start chatting.

The catalog is **fetched dynamically**: pulled in the background at startup and refreshed
every 30 minutes.

dsh-zen-adapter README · Plugin panel：The plugin's page under **Settings → Plugins → dsh-zen-adapter** has a panel with two buttons:

| Button | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **获取模型** (Fetch models) | Re-pulls the model catalog from upstream |
| **检测可用性** (Check reachability) | Sends a real request per model to see which ones answer right now |

The table below them shows: model id, context size, output limit, availability status, and the
reason behind that verdict.

dsh-zen-adapter README · Plugin panel：> **"Listed" does not mean "working".** Real-world availability of the free models depends on
> upstream endpoint health, regional restrictions, and **per-IP quotas** — all of which change
> without notice. Run **检测可用性** once in a new environment.

dsh-zen-adapter README · Where the model list comes from：The plugin reads two upstream sources and combines them:

| Source | Provides | Does not provide |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opencode.ai/inference/v1/models` | Ids of models currently **on sale** | Pricing, context size |
| `models.dev/api.json` | `cost`, `limit.context`, `limit.output` | Whether a model is on sale |

The second source is mandatory — upstream's `/v1/models` only returns
`{ id, object, created, owned_by }`, so **there is no way to tell from it whether a model is
free**.
section: Where the model list comes from

text:
dsh-zen-adapter README · Where the model list comes from：The **free determination** is based on models.dev's `cost` (both `input` and `output` are 0).
Deprecated or paid models are rejected even if their id ends in `-free`, because upstream keeps
retired models in the catalog for a while. The `-free` suffix is only used as a fallback when
metadata is missing, which normally happens for freshly released models.

Context sizes and output limits also come from models.dev, so the values shown in the panel are
real numbers rather than a fixed constant.
section: Where the model list comes from

text:
dsh-zen-adapter README · Catalog caching：The two sources are not equally volatile, so they are not cached for the same length of time:

| Data | Cached for | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| On-sale model list | 5 minutes | A new model should reach the picker promptly |
| models.dev pricing and limits | 24 hours | It rarely changes; recomputing it within a day buys nothing |

dsh-zen-adapter README · Catalog caching：The cache lives in `~/.cache/dsh-zen-adapter/catalog.db`, following the same location
convention as `dsh-free-search`. Delete that directory to clear it — nothing else is left
behind. Set `ZEN_CACHE_DIR` to relocate it.

Three things this buys in practice:

dsh-zen-adapter README · Catalog caching：- **Faster startup** — no longer waits on models.dev's document covering every provider
- **Works offline** — starting with no network still yields a complete model list
- **Fetch models still really fetches** — that button bypasses the cache and talks to
  upstream, so it cannot be answered from a stale cache

dsh-zen-adapter README · Why zero dependencies matters：This plugin declares **no `dependencies`**. Every `@deepseek-ai/*` and `@earendil-works/pi-ai`
package is a `peerDependencies` entry marked `optional`.

The reason: DSH's host already ships one copy of pi-ai, and the plugin resolves it along the
host's module tree, so exactly one copy exists on the machine.

dsh-zen-adapter README · Why zero dependencies matters：If a plugin brings its own pi-ai, the machine ends up with **two pi-ai generations**. That is
not merely wasteful — some plugins (for example `dsh-workbuddy-xdpool`) verify that the host and
the plugin use the same generation, and when they don't, every single call through that provider
fails.

This plugin can therefore be installed **alongside** other provider plugins.

dsh-zen-adapter README · Upstream limits：OpenCode's free lane is **quota'd per IP**, and some models carry **regional restrictions**.

Things you may hit:

dsh-zen-adapter README · Upstream limits：| Symptom | Cause | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `429` | Quota exhausted or too many requests too fast | Wait a moment and retry, or switch network egress |
| `403 RegionError` | The model is not offered in your region | Cannot be worked around; pick another model |
| `5xx` / `400` | Upstream endpoint temporarily broken | Pick another model and try again later |
| Model missing from the picker | Not yet classified as free | Hit **获取模型** to refresh the catalog |

dsh-zen-adapter README · Upstream limits：All of these are **upstream-side** behaviour that the plugin cannot fix. Use
**检测可用性** to see the current status of each model.

dsh-zen-adapter README · Configuration：This plugin has nothing to configure. To adjust optional behaviour you can edit the constants at
the top of `lib/index.js`:

| Constant | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PROVIDER_ID` | `zen-free` | The provider id shown in DSH |
| `SEED_MODELS` | 3 models | Placeholder list used until the catalog has been fetched |
| Catalog refresh interval | 30 minutes | See `refreshTimer` in `lib/index.js` |

dsh-zen-adapter README · Reporting issues：Please open an issue: <https://github.com/seonzzy/dsh-zen-adapter/issues/new>

Search the existing issues first — errors caused by upstream behaviour changes
(`403`, `429`, models disappearing) have usually been hit by someone else already,
and the answer is there too.

dsh-zen-adapter README · Uninstall：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> remove dsh-zen-adapter
```

Then restart DSH.
